name: Lifeguard and Swim Instructor jobs at Menlo Park swim centers (Menlo Swim and Sport)
org: Team Sheeper, Inc. (Menlo Swim and Sport), city pool operator
what_you_do: Work at Burgess Pool or Belle Haven Pool in Menlo Park, or Rinconada Pool in Palo Alto. Lifeguards watch swimmers and respond to emergencies. Swim instructors teach lessons to kids and adults.
who_can_apply: Lifeguard and Swim Instructor jobs say you must be at least 15. Lifeguards must pass a swim test (150 yards, 2 minutes treading with no hands, then 50 more). Swim instructors need a clean background check.
pay_detail: Lifeguard: $20 to $26 per hour. Swim Instructor: $23 to $28 per hour. Training is paid.
duration: Year-round and summer jobs. The swim instructor posting says shifts fit around school, sports and other jobs.
deadline_text: Postings are open with no closing date listed as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: Use the apply link to reach the Team Sheeper job board. Pick a job and apply online. Questions: customerservice@menloswim.com or 650-781-5525.
notes: The city does not hire its own pool staff. The city's aquatics page says Menlo Swim and Sport runs both swim centers under contract, and its council reports name Team Sheeper, Inc. as the operator. You do not need to be a certified lifeguard to apply, they train you. The swim instructor posting says active employees get free lifeguard certification and calls the job good for high school students.
